title: Resignificando la tecnología para las lenguas indígenas
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct a benchmark related to faith/religion. It mentions religion as a factor in social injustice and intersectional violence.
findings: The paper mentions that religion, alongside factors like ethnicity and gender, can contribute to social injustice and intersectional violence. It also notes the historical role of the Church in promoting literacy among indigenous communities, which sometimes had the unintended negative effect of altering the cultures being documented.
